figures.name: Dangun Wanggeom

ability.name: Bear Mother's Son
ability.description: All Korean allies gain +2 to all stats from the divine ancestral blessing.

figures.description: The legendary founder of Gojoseon born of the divine prince Hwanung and a bear-woman who became human.

figures.name: Haemosu

ability.name: Five Dragon Chariot
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; all allies gain +2 speed from the solar chariot's blessing.

figures.description: The divine sun prince of ancient Goguryeo who rode a chariot pulled by five dragons and fathered Jumong.

figures.name: Jumong

ability.name: Never Miss Arrow
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to one target; this attack cannot be dodged, blocked or reflected.

figures.description: The legendary founding hero of Goguryeo who fled enemies by parting the river and founded the kingdom.

figures.name: Cheoyong

ability.name: Cheoyong Dance
ability.description: Ward off all disease and plague effects for 3 turns through the divine dance.

figures.description: The dragon king's son whose mask-dance drives away disease spirits and whose generosity reformed evil.

figures.name: Dragon King of the Sea

ability.name: Dragon Palace
ability.description: Call all water allies from reserve; grant all water allies +3 to all stats.

figures.description: The Korean sea dragon king who rules an underwater crystal palace and governs rain and sea fortune.

figures.name: Baridegi

ability.name: Underworld Flowers
ability.description: Retrieve three flowers: fully restore one ally's HP and remove all death effects.

figures.description: The seventh daughter abandoned by her parents who journeys to the underworld to retrieve the medicine of life.

figures.name: Dokkaebi

ability.name: Magic Club
ability.description: Steal one buff from an enemy and grant it to one ally; the goblin's club cannot be foreseen.

figures.description: The Korean goblin born from abandoned objects who causes mischief, loves games and wields a magic club.

figures.name: Jeseok

ability.name: Rice Blessing
ability.description: Restore 3 HP to all allies; all abundance and nature allies gain +2 power.

figures.description: The heavenly Buddhist king of abundance who descends to earth as the provider of rice and fertility.

figures.name: Mago

ability.name: Grand Mother's Making
ability.description: Grant all allies +1 to all five stats from the ancient grandmother creator.

figures.description: The ancient Korean creation goddess Mago who created the world and is the grandmother of all divine beings.

figures.name: Samshin Halmoni

ability.name: Birth Blessing
ability.description: When any ally enters play, grant them +2 to all stats from the birth grandmother's blessing.

figures.description: The grandmother spirit of birth who determines each child's fate and protects pregnant women.

figures.name: Haechi

ability.name: Fire Eater
ability.description: Consume all fire effects on the field; gain +2 power for each fire effect consumed.

figures.description: The fire-eating law-enforcing creature whose image guards Seoul's gates and symbolizes justice.

figures.name: Gumiho

ability.name: Nine Tails
ability.description: Seduce one enemy: they attack their strongest ally for 1 turn instead of yours.

figures.description: The nine-tailed fox who can transform into a beautiful human and seeks to steal a human liver to become fully human.

figures.name: Yeomna

ability.name: Ten Judgments
ability.description: All dark-aligned enemies lose 2 of their highest stat from divine judgment.

figures.description: The Korean king of the underworld who judges all souls and sends them to one of the ten courts for karma review.

figures.name: Cheonjiwang

ability.name: Heaven-Earth Division
ability.description: Separate all mixed or combined effects: deal 4 damage to enemies that rely on dual-type powers.

figures.description: The heaven-earth king of the Jeju creation myth who separated the sky and earth and established order.

figures.name: Agwi

ability.name: Fire Spirit
ability.description: Inflict burning on one enemy: -1 HP per turn for 2 turns.

figures.description: The malevolent fire demon who inhabits hot places and brings illness to those who offend the household.

figures.name: Mountain God (Sansin)

ability.name: Tiger Companion
ability.description: Summon a sacred tiger ally with 6/6/8/5/6 stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Korean mountain god who rides a tiger and presides over local areas from each mountain peak.

figures.name: Imuggi

ability.name: Dragon Becoming
ability.description: If this card survives 3 turns, it transforms: gain +3 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: The Korean serpent that spends a thousand years in a river hoping to catch a yeouiju gem and become a dragon.

figures.name: Dalgi

ability.name: Treacherous Beauty
ability.description: Charm one enemy: they lose 2 wisdom and cannot use strategic abilities for 1 turn.

figures.description: The nine-tailed fox spirit who disguised herself as the consort Dalgi and led a king to ruin.

figures.name: Mireuk

ability.name: Future Dawn
ability.description: Reveal one future enemy play; grant +1 to all stats in preparation for what comes.

figures.description: The future Buddha Maitreya reinterpreted in Korean folk religion as the divine king of the coming age.

figures.name: Chamsuri

ability.name: Butterfly Dream
ability.description: Is this card awake or dreaming? For 1 turn, all damage and effects on this card are halved — uncertain reality.

figures.description: The Korean butterfly spirit who embodies the dream of reality's uncertainty.
